item.title: Cape Crooners spread holiday joy hall to hall at local nursing home
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — The Cape Crooners pass hall to hall around Trinity Grove nursing home to spread a little bit of Christmas cheer to the resident seniors. Jim Bader is the tenor for the quartet. “I like seeing the reactions on the seniors and so I like bringing joy to their days so it’s really rewarding,” said Bader. The newest member of the group, Micheal Stockman, says he loves how the residents light up...

item.title: High-speed passenger train kills 7 elephants crossing railway tracks in northeast India
item.description: Seven wild Asiatic elephants were killed and a calf was injured when a high-speed passenger train collided with a herd crossing the tracks in India's northeastern state of Assam early Saturday, local authorities said.
